titleEn: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Langley, BC? 2026 Timeline
titleZh: 兰里厨房装修需要多长时间？BC省2026年工期完整指南
contentEn:
How long does a kitchen renovation take in Langley, BC? For a standard mid-range refresh — new countertops, cabinet refinishing, updated fixtures — the answer is three to four weeks. A full kitchen gut with new layout, cabinets, and appliances takes four to six weeks. Condo kitchens add two to four weeks for building management approvals. These are real timelines from Reno Stars projects completed in Langley between 2024 and 2026.

What Defines Each Kitchen Renovation Type in Langley

Kitchen renovation timelines in Langley, BC are driven by scope. A cosmetic refresh keeps your existing cabinet boxes and addresses surfaces only. A standard renovation replaces cabinets, countertops, and fixtures throughout. A full gut changes the layout — moving plumbing, electrical, or reconfiguring the work triangle. Each type has a distinct time commitment.

Reno Stars has completed kitchen renovations across Langley (Township), Walnut Grove, and Willoughby. Every timeline below reflects a verified completed project, not an estimate.

Langley Kitchen Renovation Timeline by Scope

Renovation TypeDurationBC PermitsStrata Approval

Standard kitchen3–4 weeksNot requiredMay be required
Kitchen with island or layout change4–6 weeksMinor renovation permitRequired for condos
Full gut + structural changes6–10 weeksBuilding permit requiredRequired for condos

What Adds Time to a Langley Kitchen Renovation

Beyond scope, three factors routinely extend timelines in Langley, BC. First, Langley Township requires a minor renovation permit for layout changes that move plumbing or electrical — this adds one to two weeks to the permit window. Second, strata approvals in Willoughby and Walnut Grove condo buildings require a minimum 30-day notice to the strata corporation. Third, product lead times for imported cabinets or specialty stone can add two to four weeks regardless of construction speed.

A kitchen renovation Reno Stars completed in Walnut Grove in 2025 illustrates the standard case. A full-ripout replacement of cabinets, countertops, sink, faucet, and appliances took four weeks start to finish with a minor renovation permit included. The homeowners moved in on week four.

How long does a standard kitchen renovation take in Langley?

A standard kitchen renovation — replacing cabinets and countertops, updating fixtures, new appliances — takes three to four weeks in Langley, BC. This assumes no layout changes and no strata approval delays. Reno Stars completed a four-week Walnut Grove kitchen in 2025 that included a new island layout and minor permit.

Does Langley Township require a permit for kitchen renovations?

Langley Township requires a minor renovation permit for any kitchen work that moves plumbing, electrical, or gas connections. Cosmetic updates like cabinet refacing or new flooring do not need a permit. Permit review at Langley Township typically takes five to seven business days.

Do condos in Willoughby or Walnut Grove need strata approval for kitchen renovations?

Yes. Strata approval is required for any work that affects common property, including walls, plumbing risers, or electrical panels. The strata process in Willoughby and Walnut Grove typically requires a 30-day notice period. Reno Stars manages the strata application as part of our project service — you do not submit it yourself.

What is the biggest source of delays in Langley kitchen projects?

Product lead times for custom cabinets and specialty stone countertops are the most common source of delay in Langley kitchen renovations. Lead times for imported cabinets run two to four weeks. Reno Stars tracks lead times from the supplier before work begins and sequences trades to minimize idle time while materials are in transit.

Can Reno Stars work in both the City of Langley and Langley Township?

Yes. Reno Stars manages projects across the entire Langley area — the City of Langley, Langley Township, Walnut Grove, Willoughby, and Fort Langley. Each municipality has slightly different permit requirements; our team knows the specifics for each area and factors permit timelines into every project schedule.

兰里（Langley）厨房装修需要多长时间？在BC省兰里进行标准中档装修——新台面、橱柜翻新、更新固定装置——的答案是三到四周。全面改造厨房、涉及新布局、橱柜和电器的装修需要四到六周。公寓厨房因需要物业管理审批，还要额外增加两到四周。以下是2024年至2026年间聚星装修在兰里完成的真实项目工期。

兰里厨房装修类型及各自工期

兰里厨房装修工期取决于工程范围。美容翻新保留现有橱柜框架，仅处理表面。标准装修更换橱柜、台面和固定装置。全面改造会改变布局——移动管道、电气或重新配置工作三角区。每个类型都有明确的工期。

聚星装修团队曾在兰里（Township）、Walnut Grove和Willoughby等地完成厨房装修项目。以下每个工期都来自已验证的完工项目，而非估算。

兰里厨房装修工期对照表（按工程范围）

装修类型工期BC省许可证物业委员会审批
美容翻新1–2周无需许可证可能需要
标准厨房装修3–4周无需许可证可能需要
带岛台或布局改变4–6周小装修许可证公寓需要审批
全面改造+结构变更6–10周建筑许可证公寓需要审批

延长兰里厨房装修工期的因素

除工程范围外，有三个因素经常导致兰里厨房装修延期。第一，兰里Township要求对移动管道、电力或燃气连接的厨房工程申请小装修许可证，这会使许可审批窗口延长一至两周。第二，Willoughby和Walnut Grove公寓楼的物业委员会审批流程至少需要30天通知期。第三，进口橱柜或特殊石材的交货期可能额外增加两到四周，无论施工进度如何。

聚星装修于2025年在Walnut Grove完成的一个厨房装修项目说明了标准情况。全拆全换橱柜、台面、水槽、水龙头和电器的工程，含小装修许可证在内，从开工到入住仅用了四周时间。

为什么选择聚星装修进行兰里厨房工程

聚星装修自2015年以来一直在整个兰里地区承接厨房装修工程。我们的团队熟悉兰里Township的许可流程和Willoughby的物业要求。我们以英语、普通话和粤语直接沟通。聚星装修承接兰里、Walnut Grove、Willoughby及Fort Langley各地项目。每个工程都包含详细的项目说明和固定工期计划。

想在兰里、Walnut Grove、Willoughby或Fort Langley进行厨房装修？立即联系聚星装修获取免费报价。我们将为您详细说明许可证、物业委员会审批流程以及针对您具体工程范围的真实工期。

兰里标准厨房装修需要多长时间？

兰里标准厨房装修——更换橱柜和台面、更新固定装置、安装新电器——需要三到四周。这假设没有布局变更且无物业委员会审批延迟。聚星装修于2025年完成了一个包含新岛台布局和小许可证的四周Walnut Grove厨房工程。

兰里厨房装修需要许可证吗？

兰里Township对移动管道、电力或燃气连接的厨房工程要求小装修许可证。橱柜翻新或新地板等美容工程无需许可证。兰里Township的许可证审核通常需要五至七个工作日。

Willoughby或Walnut Grove的公寓厨房装修需要物业委员会审批吗？

需要。任何影响公共区域的工程（包括墙壁、管道立管或电力面板）都需要物业委员会审批。Willoughby和Walnut Grove的物业流程通常需要30天通知期。聚星装修作为项目服务的一部分处理物业申请——您无需亲自提交。

兰里厨房项目中延迟的最常见原因是什么？

定制橱柜和特殊石材台面的交货期是兰里厨房装修中最常见的延期原因。进口橱柜的交货期通常为两到四周。聚星装修在工程开工前跟踪供应商的交货期，并安排各工种顺序施工，以减少材料运输期间的等待时间。

聚星装修可以在兰里市和兰里Township两地施工吗？

可以。聚星装修在整个兰里地区承接项目——包括兰里市、兰里Township、Walnut Grove、Willoughby和Fort Langley。每个市政当局的许可证要求略有不同；我们的团队了解每个地区的具体规定，并将许可证时间表纳入每个项目计划中。
